name: Saint Shirobara Gakuen Petit☆Mahjong
original_name: 聖白薔薇学園 プチ☆MAHJONG
source:
New teacher transfers to a prestigious girls' school. Beautiful chairman greets him in her office. Undressing mahjong is the way to resolve disputes at this school.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2018/12/vn-of-month-june-2000-age-maniax-isumi.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
新教师转入一所名门女子学校。美丽的校长在办公室迎接他。在这所学校，解决争端的方式是脱衣麻将。

[来源：[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2018/12/vn-of-month-june-2000-age-maniax-isumi.html]vndreview[/url]]
